verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Blessed are those who dwell in Your house
They are ever praising You

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Blessed are those whose strength is in You
Whose hearts are set on our God

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
And we will go from strength to strength
Until we see You face to face

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Hear our prayer
O Lord God Almighty

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Come bless our land
As we seek You
Worship You

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
For You are holy x2
For You are holy Lord
